Aisha (Partnerships): Heads up — QBR in 5 days. We need to reallocate ~$120k MDF to cover two co-funded marketplace campaigns + top-tier enablement. Can we get rapid approvals?
Connor (Marketplace): Which partners & campaigns? I can push marketplace co-sell but need partner SKU mapping.
Aisha (Partnerships): Targets: Cloudway marketplace listing refresh (priority), SI Labs joint webinar + demo-pack, and a reserve for two HW partners' enablement. Spreadsheet: https://redwood.app/sheets/partner-mdf-alloc-2026
Ravi (Finance): Show current commitments and where you'd pull from. Post a 1-line budget delta and I'll triage.
Aisha (Partnerships): Budget delta (proposed):
```
From MDF pool: -$120,000
Pull from: General MDF reserve -$70,000; Mid-tier runway -$50,000
Allocations: Cloudway $60,000; SI Labs webinar $30,000; HW enablement (2 partners) $30,000
```
Connor (Marketplace): Cloudway OK with $60k if we commit to co-marketing placement + 2 weeks featured tile. Need scorecard KPIs updated: reg -> demo conversion and new listings.
Eve (GTM): I'll own the co-marketing deliverables and QBR slide. Will commit to 3 assets (blog, email, webinar snippet). Need creative lead by EOD tomorrow. :+1:
Ravi (Finance): Provisional approval from finance if legal confirms co-funding terms (T&Cs) — I'll escalate to finance head and legal now. Expect decision within 48h.
partner-bot: Reminder — MDF policy requires post-campaign ROI report within 90 days and submission via /mdf-request. See policy: https://redwood.app/policy/mdf.
Aisha (Partnerships): Can we do a 30m sync today to sign off and map tasks? @Ravi @Eve @Connor
Connor (Marketplace): 3:30pm PT works for me.
Eve (GTM): I can do 3:45pm PT — ok for a 15m overlap? 3:45 if that helps.
Ravi (Finance): 4:00pm PT is tight for me. If 3:30 works for Connor and Aisha, I can join for the first 15 min to confirm finance path.
Aisha (Partnerships): Let's do 3:30pm PT — we'll cover approvals first 15m, then ops/tactics.
Connor (Marketplace): I'll prepare updated scorecard metrics and the Cloudway placement brief.
Eve (GTM): I'll drop draft talking points and creative brief into the sheet before the sync.
Ravi (Finance): I'll queue the provisional approval and loop legal. If legal flags anything, we'll have contingency: split funding over two quarters.
Aisha (Partnerships): Action items before sync: 1) Aisha update spreadsheet with final line items (done) 2) Connor update scorecard KPIs + placement brief 3) Eve prep QBR slide + creative brief 4) Ravi escalate to finance head + legal. I'll ping when legal responds.
Connor (Marketplace): :thumbsup:
Eve (GTM): Thanks — see you at 3:30.
partner-bot: Note: use /mdf-request with the spreadsheet link once approvals are confirmed to avoid processing delays.
